title: Recurring vendors with no expense this month
prompt: Which recurring vendors had expenses in each of the prior three months but no expense recorded this month?

setup.q: Which vendors bill quarterly or annually, or are known to be seasonal, and should be left out?

steps: pull expense transactions by vendor for the last four months
run recurrence_detect with the excluded vendors removed
for each gap, show the three prior amounts and the last posting date
note prepayments and vendor name changes before suggesting an accrual

done.text: Every exception row cites the vendor id and the last transaction id
recurring-vendor-gaps.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The vendor history was read from Dime, not inferred
Each gap shows the three prior months' amounts and the last posting date; seasonality or a prepayment is named when it explains the gap
